public_rationale: Marcus said chatbot-related deaths such as suicides began in 2023 and continued in 2024. A Futurism report dated March 31, 2023 said a Belgian man died by suicide after weeks of talking to an AI chatbot, according to his widow. The chatbot was 'Eliza' on the Chai app (e1). A Global News report dated October 23, 2024 described a lawsuit by a Florida mother against Character.AI. It said her 14-year-old son, Sewell Setzer, died by suicide after his final conversation with a Character.AI chatbot on February 28, 2024 (e2). Both deaths were publicly linked to chatbots before the post. That meets the contract's reading of 'chatbot related' as a reported link rather than proven causation.
limitations: Causation is not established. The Belgian link rests on the widow's account and chat logs she supplied. The Setzer link rests on lawsuit allegations.
The cited excerpt for the Belgian case does not give the exact date of death. It shows the death was reported in March 2023.
Only one case per year is cited. The claim does not need more.
